title: A Study Assessing the Effect of Dupilumab on Inducing Clinical Remission in Asthma
note: Simplified for the demo, not the full protocol. Key criteria only.

criteria.text: Physician diagnosis of asthma for at least 6 months
Documented variable airflow: a positive reversibility test, FEV1 variability between visits, a positive bronchial challenge, or peak flow variability over 20%
criteria.reason: Reversibility and challenge test results aren't in the record. Check pulmonary function reports.

criteria.text: Blood eosinophils at least 0.3 × 10⁹/L and FeNO at least 35 ppb at screening
criteria.reason: Measured at the screening visit. FeNO isn't in the record and eosinophils rarely are.

criteria.text: At least one asthma attack in the last 2 years needing oral or injected steroids for 3+ days, or an emergency or hospital visit

question.instructions: Did this patient have at least one asthma attack in the last 2 years that needed a course of oral steroids (such as prednisone) or an emergency or hospital visit? Choose MATCH if the record shows an emergency or hospital admission for asthma, or a short oral steroid course alongside an active asthma diagnosis, in the last 2 years. Choose NO_MATCH if the record covers the last 2 years and shows no asthma-related emergency visits, admissions or steroid courses. Choose UNKNOWN if there are emergency or urgent care visits with no reason recorded, or the record can't settle it.

criteria.text: Stable at least medium-dose inhaled corticosteroid (over 250 mcg/day fluticasone propionate or equivalent) for at least 3 months

question.instructions: Is this patient on a maintenance inhaled corticosteroid (fluticasone, budesonide, beclomethasone, mometasone, ciclesonide), alone or combined with a long-acting bronchodilator, started at least 3 months ago and still active? Choose MATCH if so and the inhaler strength suggests at least a medium dose (fluticasone propionate 250 mcg per day or more, or equivalent). Choose NO_MATCH if there is no inhaled corticosteroid on the medication list, or only a rescue inhaler like albuterol. Choose UNKNOWN if an inhaled corticosteroid is present but the dose or duration can't be told from the record.

criteria.text: Current smoker, or quit less than 6 months ago
criteria.notes: Ex-smokers pass here. Their quit date and pack-years are checked at screening.

criteria.text: Other significant lung disease, including COPD, lung fibrosis, sarcoidosis, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary hypertension or bronchiectasis
Active cancer or a cancer in the last 5 years (except basal cell skin cancer)
criteria.notes: Suspected-cancer findings aren't counted; basal cell carcinoma isn't in this data.

criteria.text: Recent monoclonal antibody treatment for asthma
Already eligible for dupilumab through an approved use, such as atopic dermatitis or nasal polyps

locationNote: Runs in Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia only, per the public record. A U.S. practice couldn't join it; it stays in the demo as a real example of the criteria.
